scope: Current-environment execution decisions; unavailable stages stay unexecuted and missing integration stays unimplemented

items.label: Reduce unresolved startup kernel consumption
items.implementation: Bounded source, metadata, reservation, quiet-start and controller audits completed; no supported reclaim implementation
items.reason: No removable owned cause or callable OS reclaim owner was established. This is unavailable through established interfaces, not proof that all possible code changes are impossible.
items.reopen_only_after: A supported measured reduction of the initial CPU interval, or a material independently established resource change; no reboot dependency

items.label: Invariant batch metadata reuse
items.implementation: Native CPU prototype qualified; not linked into production
items.reason: Specific-loop generous saving is only 0.1334 ms per fixed request; no full-model replay is justified solely for it.
items.reopen_only_after: Evidence of a different material repeated metadata cost

items.label: Allocation lifetime and constant-reuse audit
items.implementation: Existing owner/alias ledger and original tensor audit completed
items.reason: Rehearsal reservations are already released; fixed GDN parameters are already F32. No supported additional saving repairs the earlier initial CPU decline.
items.reopen_only_after: An identified owned allocation with a proven final consumer and material reclaimable cost

items.label: Additional full-model peak-live characterization
items.implementation: Additional native instrumentation/coverage is not completed
items.reason: Requires another admitted model lifetime. Existing global page deltas do not identify an exclusive proprietary owner.
items.reopen_only_after: An admitted changed full-model scope with priced observation cost

items.label: 53/128-slot A/B/B/A
items.implementation: 128-slot implementation, 360 layout graphs and independent reviewers qualified; A53 completed three requests
items.reason: B128/B128/A53 did not run: screen 3174 observed 6583 pages against staged CPU entry 8159. The cohort is not a completed benchmark.
items.reopen_only_after: Material startup/resource change and a newly frozen complete matched cohort; do not resume the old unmatched arms

items.label: Further cache capacities
items.implementation: Fifteen capacities replayed; additional native capacity integrations are not implemented
items.reason: No completed native capacity winner or admitted model cost profile supports another capacity integration.
items.reopen_only_after: Completed executable capacity comparison and a priced next candidate

items.label: Complete model checkpoint
items.implementation: Complete-model continuation physically qualified
items.reason: Correctness prerequisite passed; prefix/speculative speed benefits are separate and unproven.
items.reopen_only_after: Changed state/model/precision implementation; no unchanged correctness rerun

items.label: Exact-prefix reuse TTFT
items.implementation: Default-off consumer and reviewers host-qualified
items.reason: Requires the same full-model startup path; no native prefix speed comparison completed.
items.reopen_only_after: Material startup/resource change, then a fresh matched prefix cohort

items.label: Width-two exact verification and speed
items.implementation: Causal native policy/controller, complete checkpoint and 30 adapter controls exist
items.reason: Actual acceptance, forced rejection/restore, continuation/routes and speed require another admitted model lifetime.
items.reopen_only_after: Material startup/resource change, native exactness first and matched speed second

items.label: Width-four verification
items.implementation: Dependent model integration is not implemented
items.reason: Native width-two arithmetic, rollback and cost prerequisites are missing. Host code could be written, but validated integration cannot be completed now.
items.reopen_only_after: Qualified native width two and a separately priced width-four scope

items.label: Radiance-inspired adaptive draft depth
items.implementation: Dependent adaptive model integration is not implemented
items.reason: No native fixed-width acceptance/cost result exists to select or validate the controller.
items.reopen_only_after: Qualified fixed-width verification and measured acceptance, rollback and source costs

items.label: Original-file versus expert-major delivery
items.implementation: Actual original-byte bank/source comparison executed
items.reason: Eight rounds, seven faster; about 1.040x source and 1.037x total did not meet the original screen. No full repack/integration follows.
items.reopen_only_after: A materially different delivery mechanism supported by new evidence

items.label: Original-source CPU two-call reader
items.implementation: Actual shared reader completed eight cases and 240 matrix deliveries
items.reason: Source-only ratio 1.06735x. Production already uses qualified paired reads; this is not a new model-speed or adoption proof.
items.reopen_only_after: A distinct production-path delta with a relevant model comparison

items.label: Ready-expert split overlap
items.implementation: All 40 original-source/backing/numerical GPU graphs completed
items.reason: Both reverse comparisons were about 0.9-1.4% slower; stop this variant before model integration.
items.reopen_only_after: A materially different mechanism that removes the measured overhead

items.label: Actual hidden-state router observation
items.implementation: Shadow prototype host-qualified; actual model capture integration is not implemented
items.reason: Needs actual FFN hidden states and an admitted tap off/on model cost comparison. Recorded selected IDs cannot substitute.
items.reopen_only_after: Admitted model lifetime and priced actual hidden-state observation

items.label: Hidden-state forecast and speculative transfers
items.implementation: Dependent actual model forecast/transfer integration is not implemented
items.reason: Actual hidden-state usefulness, ready-before-demand and added-cost measurements are missing; no justified transfer candidate exists.
items.reopen_only_after: Measured observation benefit exceeding forecast, eviction and I/O costs

items.label: Broader workload quality and performance
items.implementation: Four original-template/tokenizer metadata cases completed
items.reason: Native token equality, answer quality and matched metrics require additional admitted model requests. Host metadata is not quality evidence.
items.reopen_only_after: Admitted model scope and a surviving candidate requiring workload regression

items.label: PLE copy-elision modes at widths one through four
items.implementation: All 208 alternating physical graphs, numerical and retirement checks completed
items.reason: Median effects -0.092% to +0.046% with mixed wins; no repeatable speed winner. No model integration follows.
items.reopen_only_after: A materially different PLE mechanism

items.label: Radiance shared-input projections
items.implementation: Actual tensor/shape audit completed; portable Vulkan kernel is not implemented
items.reason: Donor MXFP4 merging does not implement original BF16/F32. Native material per-kernel cost and numerical comparison are absent; the 80 MiB weight pair remains.
items.reopen_only_after: An admitted material-cost profile and a separately priced portable numerical fixture

items.label: Radiance GDN and gated-normalization fusion
items.implementation: Original F32 and sigmoid semantics audited; portable additional fusion is not implemented
items.reason: RDNA4 HIP/WMMA and device-wide barrier assumptions do not directly transfer. No measured eligible native target justifies a validated integration.
items.reopen_only_after: Measured uncovered cost and an independently qualified Vulkan design preserving original semantics

items.label: Radiance small dense projection dispatch
items.implementation: Actual one/two/four-token type/shape eligibility reviewed; additional kernel is not implemented
items.reason: Donor BF16-only M>=6 path does not match the F32/current widths. Native target profile and portable numerical/performance comparison are missing.
items.reopen_only_after: Measured eligible native shape/cost and a separately qualified portable candidate

items.label: Further vector/workgroup specialization
items.implementation: Qualified indexed-vector route retained; further tuning is not implemented
items.reason: Existing non-source time includes CPU/guards/transfer/completion, not isolated shader cost. No material kernel target has been established.
items.reopen_only_after: An admitted model profile identifying material kernel cost with bounded observation overhead
